text_blocks.snippet: For most individuals, COVID-19 symptoms tend to peak around days 8-10. During this period, fever, respiratory distress, and other symptoms may be at their most intense. Following this peak, symptoms may plateau or begin to gradually improve, particularly if supportive care and treatment are effective, with some noticing improvement around days 13-14.
